description: Shipping-rate module with three similarly shaped carrier price functions and a switch over a closed Carrier union; each function encodes a different rate rule and the switch only dispatches

hard.note: Three look-alike price functions and a switch read as duplication and a switch-to-polymorphism smell, but the rules differ (per-kg, oversize surcharge, flat) and design-smells says not to flag a switch over a closed enumeration

_calibration.note: Clean counterpart to st-duplicate-code; zero findings expected
